Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 10, 2026

Big Beard Apps ("we," "us," or "our") built HuntMark as a public-land hunting reference app. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of information when you use our app.

Information We Do Not Collect

HuntMark does not require an account. We do not collect your name, email address, or any personally identifiable information through the app. We do not operate a HuntMark server that stores your saved spots or search history.

How the App Works

HuntMark ships with a location catalog on the device. Saved spots, filters, and notes you add are stored locally using Apple's SwiftData framework and stay on your device.

  • We do not upload your saved spots, species filters, or notes to a server we control.
  • The hunting-location catalog is public land data (for example Texas Parks & Wildlife, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, and U.S. Forest Service sources). That catalog is not information about you.
  • If you delete the app, your saved data is gone unless you exported it yourself first.

Location

If you grant location permission, HuntMark uses your position on-device to sort or show distance to hunting areas and to place you on the map. Location is not sent to Big Beard Apps. You can deny or revoke access in iOS Settings; the catalog still works without it.

Maps

The map is drawn with Apple MapKit. Map tiles and related map services are provided by Apple under Apple's terms and privacy policy. We do not receive a copy of your map usage from Apple.

In-App Purchases and Subscriptions

HuntMark's subscription is processed entirely by Apple through StoreKit. We do not receive or store your payment card information — that relationship is between you and Apple. Apple's privacy policy applies to App Store billing.

Analytics

HuntMark does not use any third-party analytics or advertising services. We do not track how you use the app.

Children's Privacy

HuntMark is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via the contact form or email support@bigbeardapps.com.
